note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file). The prepare turns asyncautodelete off in plugins.json for the recording only; teardown restores the file with git.
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
if (-not (Test-Path ./src/MGLab.D365.Plugins/MGLab.D365.Plugins.snk)) { throw 'Create the strong-name key first with sn -k in a Visual Studio developer prompt (never committed).' }
manual_prepare: In DEV app: Settings, Administration, System Settings, Customization: Enable logging to plug-in trace log = All.
Create the classic background workflow 'Recalculate risk (classic)' on Project Request (trigger Budget change, one Stop Workflow step), save, do not activate.
After the first deploy: add Risk Score (mgl_riskscore) read-only to the main form next to Budget and publish.
PR-0004: Budget 42,000, due date about 10 days ahead, empty Business Justification. Run apikit backfill --apply (done by the form screen prepare).

screens.name: form-riskscore
steps: Open a private browser window and sign in as alex.demo
Select DEV, Apps, open the Project Requests model-driven app
Open PR-0004: Risk Score shows the low value
Change Budget from 42,000 to 75,000 (Business Justification stays empty) and save
Wait 10 to 30 seconds, refresh: Risk Score updates (real value, expected about 75)
